facts.fact: TechCabal reports NIMC had issued about 124 million unique NINs by October 2025.
NIMC began migrating the ID system to MOSIP in July 2025, with an $83 million system integrator tender for NIMS 2.0 under the World Bank-backed ID4D programme.
NIMC says it has held ISO 27001 certification since 2014, now upgraded to the 2022 standard.

systems.system: National Identity Management System (NIMS 2.0 on MOSIP)
